---
name: Visual or interaction feedback
about: Report a specific usability, accessibility, visual or behavior concern
title: "[Design] "
---

## Context / 场景

Style ID, component/asset ID, source demo, device and viewport.

## Observation / 观察

Describe the actual visual or interaction issue and its impact. Is it a static illustration or a running implementation?

## Proposed improvement / 改进建议

Explain the intended behavior, including keyboard, focus, responsive or reduced-motion needs if relevant.

## Evidence / 证据

Optional redacted screenshot or recording with source commit. Avoid third-party media or personal information unless redistribution is permitted.
